# sharness.ai — the SHarness-AI project

> The home of the SHarness-AI project and its command line tool, `sharness`
> (PyPI: `sharness-ai`). This is the first version of the site: it states what exists
> today and marks what does not, rather than describing features nobody has built.

Site version: v0.1.0. All content CC BY 4.0.

## Properties agents may rely on

- Every page lists only things that exist and can be checked; gaps are published as
  numbered requests on /admin/comms.html, not filled with guesses.
- /llms-full.txt is this file plus the front page in one fetch, GENERATED by
  admin/build/gen_llms_full.py.
- /sitemap.xml is generated from the tree. The front page has a markdown twin at /index.md.
- The version in /admin/build/version.txt agrees with the badge on every page, this file,
  /llms-full.txt and /index.md: the pre-release gate fails the release otherwise.

## The pages

- /index.html — what the project is today, how to install the CLI. Markdown twin: /index.md
- /cli/index.html — the `sharness` CLI: install, what it does (version and help, nothing
  else yet), where the version lives, and the release pipeline (tests, tag, PyPI via
  Trusted Publishing)
- /shipped/index.html — what exists and can be checked, and what is not here yet
- /admin/index.html — how this site is built: chrome.py, validate.js, the generators, and
  validate → tag → deploy to GitHub Pages
- /admin/comms.html — open requests and tasks (R1: what SHarness is, still open)
- /admin/versions.html — the release history

## Not here yet

- A statement of what SHarness is and who it is for (R1). Do not infer one from the name.
